dataset: Forbes World's Billionaires List 2025 (39th annual list), top 206, plus Forbes 2025 celebrity-billionaire extras
asOf: March 7, 2025 (stock prices and exchange rates used by Forbes for the 2025 annual list)
sourceNote: Main tranche: Forbes 2025 annual list, ranks 1-199 with ties (206 people), figures from stock prices and exchange rates on March 7, 2025; the full 2025 list has 3,028 billionaires worth $16.1 trillion combined. Extra tranche: 5 billionaires from Forbes' 2025 celebrity-billionaire reporting who have publicly documented jets (Swift, Kardashian, Jordan, Jay-Z, Trump). Net worths are estimates and move daily; this file is a snapshot, not a live feed.
